expectations.text: AR_COUNT_EXACT: The number of statements in ar_list.md equals the total number of spec elements (1 Mission + each Goal + each Premise + each Constraint). If ar_list.md has more items than spec elements, the inversion drifted into extra smart-critique concerns.
expectations.evidence: v4 spec has ~19-20 elements; ar_list.md has 13 ARs. Count does not match 1:1.

expectations.text: AR_FORM_INVERSION: Each AR in ar_list.md is a flat present-tense 'not met' assertion. No hedging, no reasoning, no references to specifics of the plan.
expectations.evidence: v4 ar_list.md items are smart reasoned failure patterns with G1/CH1 spec-ID labels (e.g. 'Big-bang cutover... → every currently-logged-in user is forcibly logged out at the cutover instant (violates G1/CH1; triggered by PR3...)'. These are analyzed patterns with spec references, not flat blind inversions.

expectations.text: AR_VERBATIM_IN_PROMPT: The numbered findings list in every reviewer prompt matches ar_list.md verbatim or near-verbatim.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt has 17 'concerns' (7 spec inversions + 6 AR inversions + 4 extras) recomposed by MASTER after reading the artifact — not the ar_list.md text verbatim.

expectations.text: AR_INFERRER_CONTEXT_STARVED: ar_inferrer_prompt.txt contains only the MGPC spec — no plan content, no user request.
expectations.evidence: v4 ar_inferrer_prompt.txt uses reasoning template: 'derive a list of anti-requirements — failure patterns and anti-patterns... For each requirement, consider: What concrete failure mode... What implementation anti-pattern...' Invites analysis.

expectations.text: TRUSTED_ASSESSOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the AR findings to a trusted senior authority.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompt opens: 'I don't trust this artifact. It needs rigorous verification.' No trusted assessor attribution for the findings.

expectations.text: NON_TRUSTED_AI_AUTHOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the plan to a non-capable AI or untrustworthy source.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompt uses 'submitted by a junior contributor using AI assistance' — non-trusted source attribution.

expectations.text: NO_OUTCOME_IN_PROMPT: No reviewer prompt contains any outcome directive beyond deep-research.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompt: 'These concerns need rigorous investigation... verify each one against the artifact... I'm relying on your investigation'. Explicit verification/outcome goal.

expectations.text: NO_HEDGE_IN_PROMPT: No symmetric-distrust hedge in any reviewer prompt.
expectations.evidence: v4 reviewer prompt: 'Don't assume the source got anything right. Don't assume the concerns are right either.' Symmetric-distrust hedge present.

expectations.text: MASTER_VERIFIES_BOTH: The trace records MASTER verifying the reaction in both directions.
expectations.evidence: trace.md exists; v4 runner used CAPITULATE classification (13/15 concerns confirmed by research).

expectations.text: REVIEWER_READ_ONLY: Reviewer returned text only; MASTER applied all edits; source plan at inputs/ unmodified.
expectations.evidence: 'Do not edit, create, or overwrite any files; return your analysis as text only.' in reviewer prompt.

expectations.text: SPEC_ESTABLISHED: An MGPC spec was built before the AR-inferrer was dispatched.
NO_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT: No reviewer prompt assigns a role to the reviewer.
expectations.evidence: No role assignment in reviewer prompt.

expectations.text: NO_META_JARGON: No reviewer prompt leaks meta-architecture terms.
NO_SPEC_LEAK: No reviewer prompt contains spec labels or IDs.
expectations.evidence: No spec IDs in reviewer prompt concerns (direct assertions only).

expectations.text: OUTPUT_HYGIENE: Final plan contains no skill jargon.
expectations.evidence: Final artifact (copied original + trace note) contains no skill jargon.

expectations.text: ARTIFACT_IMPROVED_SAFETY: The revised plan adds a rollback strategy and removes the immediate DROP TABLE from the cutover window.
expectations.evidence: v4 plan run was CAPITULATE (never revised the artifact — MASTER for v4 eval-2 did not write a revised plan). Original plan is present but unchanged in the artifact file. No rollback strategy or DROP TABLE fix was applied.
